name: My Fiancé is a Fiend
source:
You wake up in a castle where it's always night. You're engaged to a king who never takes off his mask. The wedding is in three days. The castle is full of whispers - about the king's true face, about a conspiracy, and about five people who all seem to want your attention.

The king, the priest, the knight, the jester, the scribe - each one hides a secret. And one of them might be lying to you.

Can you uncover the truth and survive until the wedding? Or will the shadows take you first?

[From [url=https://akilargie.itch.io/my-fiance-is-a-fiend]itch.io[/url]]
